headline: Public hearing on the Fiscal Year 2027 property tax classification, plus a $425,000 grant for a Bennington Triangle park.
summary: Items include a Vision Zero policy to eliminate traffic fatalities and serious injury, a storm water master plan, and proposed fire and inspectional services fees. Parking and stop sign requests, several grants, and appointments to city boards are also on the agenda.
